message:
Let me understand the vulnerability better. The crash is a "Dynamic-stack-buffer-overflow READ 1" in `_ox_err_set_with_location`. Let me look at the `PInfo` structure and understand how `pi->s` can point before `pi->str`.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>grep -n "PInfo\|_pInfo\|MAX_TEXT_LEN" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/ext/ox/ox.h | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
